title: Pete the Pirate and the treasure map.
lines: A wooden ship is sailing on the wide sea.
It has white sails and a black flag with a skull.
The ship is called The Crooked Tub.
And the captain is Pete the Pirate.
Pete has a red scarf around his head, a striped shirt and boots.
He is cheerful, brave and he loves to sing.
Three more pirates live on his ship.
He is big and strong, and he cooks the strangest soups.
Stien is the only woman on the ship.
She is clever and she always knows what to do.
And Steven is the youngest pirate.
One morning Steven is fishing with a rod.
He feels something on the line.
What comes out of the water?
With a piece of paper inside.
Pete the Pirate pulls the cork out of the bottle.
He takes out the paper and unrolls it.
There's an island on the map.
There's a big palm tree on it.
And under the palm tree there's a big red cross.
If we sail south, we'll be there tomorrow.
The pirates pull on the ropes.
And The Crooked Tub sails over the waves.
But what the pirates don't know: someone else is listening in.
Behind a big barrel sits Captain Sabretooth.
He's a nasty pirate with a long black beard.
He has tied a little boat to the back of The Crooked Tub.
The next morning they reach Banana Island.
There are white beaches, blue waves and green palm trees.
They row the rowing boat to the beach.
They look for the big palm tree.
There are a hundred palm trees!
Stien looks carefully at the map.
Something is written here, she says.
Ten steps from the rock that looks like a turtle.
It really does look like a turtle, with a head and four legs.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
Berend starts digging with his spade.
A wooden chest with iron edges.
But then they hear a voice.
He jumps out from behind a bush.
And he runs off with it to his little boat.
But Steven is quicker than anyone thinks.
But he trips right into Captain Sabretooth.
Sabretooth falls over, with his nose in the sand.
The chest flies through the air and lands next to Pete.
Even if it was an accident!
Captain Sabretooth runs to his little boat and quickly rows away.
And inside that an even smaller chest.
And inside that an even smaller one.
A pirate's greatest treasure is his friends.
He puts his arms around Stien, Berend and Steven.
I have the best treasure on the whole sea!
That evening Berend makes a big pot of soup.
And they sing pirate songs until the stars come out.
